strings.name: Pony Ma
strings.summary: A Shenzhen University graduate, Ma developed communications software before co-founding Tencent in 1998. It expanded from QQ messaging into WeChat, games and digital content. He led strategy and management and pledged shares to philanthropy. Tencent’s market power has raised competition, data-governance and regulatory controversies; its products reflect many teams’ work.
